content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The post sits in the Department of Endocrinology at AIIMS Jodhpur, in Jodhpur. The ICMR-funded extramural project is a single-arm trial of islet transplantation in Type 1 DM, with a gene expression study. The selected person works in the Islet Isolation Laboratory and GMP facility, in the team that isolates and manufactures human islets for transplantation.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only one post is advertised. Its essential qualification, as printed, is a three-year Graduate degree in Life Sciences / Biotechnology / Biochemistry / Microbiology / Zoology / Medical Laboratory Technology or a relevant subject with three years of relevant experience from a recognised institution; OR a Post-Graduate degree in the above subjects. Experience in cell culture, tissue processing or a clinical / research laboratory working under aseptic conditions. Experience of working in a clean room, blood bank component laboratory or GMP facility. Basic computer skills for data entry. Aseptic technique and cell culture basics. Accurate laboratory work and documentation. Willingness for on-call work. The age limit is 35 years. Age, education qualification and experience are considered as on the critical date, 03.12.2026. Age relaxation of up to 5 years may be granted to deserving candidates with experience in a Government Research Organisation on ICMR projects, on a case-by-case basis, as per ICMR Rules. All educational, professional and technical qualifications must be from a recognised Board/University and be full-time. Qualifications may be relaxed for highly experienced, trained or reputed candidates only at the discretion of the Selection Committee. Experience should preferably be from a Government Organisation / recognised organisation. It is counted after the date of completion of the Minimum Essential Qualification, and experience in the relevant field or area is considered. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration is ₹ 28,000 + 20% HRA per month (~₹ 33,600). The notice calls the salary a consolidated sum without any other benefits, as prescribed by the ICMR and based on the funds sanctioned for the project. The position is initially for 12 months. It may be extended for an additional 12 months based on project requirements and the performance appraisal. The notice also says the appointment is for 12 months or till further notice, whichever is earlier. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The selected candidate is expected to join within 15 days of the offer of appointment.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Support-III Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the work as part of the islet isolation and manufacturing team, in coordination with the PI. The appointee carries out all tasks assigned by the PI from time to time. The listed duties are: Receipt of the donor pancreas under cold chain and chain-of-custody documentation. Human islet isolation and islet manufacturing: pancreas trimming, ductal cannulation, collagenase perfusion, digestion (Ricordi method), density-gradient purification on the COBE 2991 cell processor, islet culture and final product preparation. Islet quality testing: islet count (IEQ), purity (dithizone), viability (FDA/PI), glucose-stimulated insulin secretion and sampling for sterility, endotoxin and gene expression. Working in the clean room (Grade A/B) as per GMP/GLP; preparation and quality control of media, enzymes and reagents. Contemporaneous documentation in batch manufacturing records, logbooks and SOP-based forms (ALCOA+). Cleaning, disinfection and readiness of the isolation laboratory and clean room before and after each isolation; autoclaving and sterilisation. Maintenance of stock registers, temperature logs and biomedical waste segregation. Any other technical work assigned by the PI. On-call duty: islet isolation depends on the availability of a donor pancreas, which can be offered at any hour. The incumbent must be available on call 24 × 7, including nights, Sundays and holidays. The incumbent must be able to report to the Islet Isolation Laboratory at short notice and work through an isolation that can last 10–14 hours. No additional remuneration is payable for on-call or extended duty.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Support-III
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications in the prescribed format and says eligible applicants can walk in and submit their application by 03.12.2026 (10.00 AM). It gives no online link and no postal address for applications. The prescribed format, "Application for Research Project Human Resource Position (on Temporary Basis)", is attached to the notice. It is to be filled in capital letters. Fill in the prescribed application format: name, date of birth, age, caste category, addresses, email, phone, qualifications from High School onwards, experience and two referees. Attach self-attested photocopies of the relevant documents; the notice says an application without the necessary certificates and proofs is incomplete. Report in person on 03.12.2026 at 09:30 AM at the Department of Endocrinology, Room no 135, AIIMS Jodhpur, Basni Industrial Area Phase 2, Jodhpur 342005. Carry a printout of the filled form, all relevant original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies and a CV / Brief Profile for the written test and interview. Arrange two letters of recommendation in the prescribed format. Each referee sends the letter from an official email ID to [email protected] by 03.12.2026, or the candidate brings it in a sealed envelope signed across the flap. Birth Certificate / Proof of DOB, and Identity Proof. Caste Certificate (for SC/ST/OBC). Higher Secondary Certificate, UG Degree Certificate, PG Degree Certificate, PhD Degree Certificate (as applicable). UG Marksheet and PG Marksheets; marksheets are not accepted in place of degree certificates as proof of essential qualification. Additional qualification certificates, CV / Brief Profile and experience certificates. No Objection Certificate (NOC) for persons working in the Government, a Public Sector Undertaking or other research projects. Degree Certificates or Provisional Pass Certificates are required. The notice also mentions a printout of the application form "received in your email after the due submission of the form".

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection runs in up to two stages. If more than 10 eligible candidates report, a written screening test is held. The test lasts 60 minutes. Section A has 20 MCQs for 40 marks, and Section B is an essay (research/laboratory report from hypothetical cell culture data) for 20 marks. Generally up to the top 10 candidates are shortlisted for evaluation. If 10 or fewer eligible candidates report, all proceed to evaluation and the written test is taken without a cut-off. Evaluation is out of 100 marks and covers the written test, credentials, letters of recommendation and the personal interview. The PI reserves the right to shortlist candidates for the further selection process. The Selection Committee may contact the referees, and a missing or unverifiable letter is scored zero. Letters from relatives are not accepted.
